## Architecture Overview

The `DataSourceConnection` struct is defined in `grafana/pkg/apis/query/v0alpha1/connection.go`. It defines how Grafana connects to backends like Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, and Tempo. Adding a required `AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig` field breaks all struct literal instantiations and requires regeneration of auto-generated code.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`connection.go`** (lines 13-22) — Defines the `DataSourceConnection` struct itself. Adding the required field here is the primary change.

### Auto-Generated Code (Must Regenerate)

- **`zz_generated.deepcopy.go`** (lines 94-118) — Auto-generated deepcopy methods. Must be regenerated to include the new field.
- **`zz_generated.openapi.go`** (lines 199-248) — Auto-generated OpenAPI schema. `schema_pkg_apis_query_v0alpha1_DataSourceConnection()` must include the new field.

### Struct Instantiation Sites (Direct Breaks)

- **`connections.go`** (lines 138-151) — The `asConnection()` method creates `DataSourceConnection` struct literals. This is the CRITICAL break point. All datasource plugin connections go through here.
- **`register.go`** (line 162) — Scheme registration with `&query.DataSourceConnection{}`. Breaks without the required field.
- **`register.go`** in v0alpha1 (lines 20-22) — Factory function `func() runtime.Object { return &DataSourceConnection{} }`. Empty instantiation breaks.

### Provider Interface

- **`connections.go`** (lines 29-36) — `DataSourceConnectionProvider` interface returning `*queryV0.DataSourceConnection`. All implementations must construct valid instances.

### Test Files

- **`sub_query_test.go`** (lines 101-102) — Mock implementation of `GetConnection()` returning `(*queryV0.DataSourceConnection, error)`.

## Relevant Files

|------|-----------|-----|
| grafana | pkg/apis/query/v0alpha1/connection.go | DataSourceConnection struct definition |

| grafana | pkg/apis/query/v0alpha1/zz_generated.openapi.go | Auto-generated OpenAPI schema |
| grafana | pkg/apis/query/v0alpha1/register.go | Factory function with empty DataSourceConnection{} |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/query/connections.go | asConnection() creates struct literals; DataSourceConnectionProvider interface |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/query/register.go | Scheme registration with &query.DataSourceConnection{} |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/datasource/sub_query_test.go | Mock GetConnection() returning DataSourceConnection |
